Gus and Pia trust Rey to gather logistics and escalate resource gaps to Rosa.

Pia and Eli are organizing a community repair drive, with Rey gathering tools, needs, availability, and gaps.
Uli is a detail-oriented helper focused on setup logistics and avoiding misinformation.

events.text: Rey: Hi Pia, I heard a little about the repair drive, but not much yet. What are you hoping people can help with?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Mostly I’m hoping people can help with the practical bits—where we’ll set up tables, who’s bringing tools, and how we’ll keep the line from getting chaotic.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rey: That makes sense; maybe I can help by checking in with a few people one-on-one about tools and table space. What’s the most urgent gap right now?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: Hi Eli, I heard a little about the repair drive, but not much yet. What are you hoping neighbors can help with?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Eli: I’d like us to keep it simple: list what needs fixing, match folks with the skills or tools, and set one clear Saturday morning to do the work.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Rey: That sounds doable. I can ask a few neighbors what they need fixed and what tools they might be willing to lend.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: Hi Gus, I’ve only heard pieces so far, but I’m trying to help quietly by checking what people need fixed and what tools or table space they can offer. What part of the repair drive are you most worried about?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Gus: Mostly the flow of it, Rey—making sure folks know when to show up and that we’ve got enough table space, bins, and the right tools ready before things get crowded.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Rey: That sounds practical; I can ask around one-on-one about extra tables, bins, and tools, and maybe help spread a simple time window so people don’t all arrive at once.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Gus: That’d be a big help, Rey—if you can quietly find out who has folding tables, bins, and extension cords, I’ll round up my tools and check in with Pia about the sign-up flow.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Rey: I can do that, Gus—I’ll ask around for folding tables, bins, and extension cords, and I’ll keep a simple list so we know what’s actually available.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Gus: Perfect, Rey—if you send me that list when you’ve got a few names, I’ll match it against what I can bring and make sure Pia knows what gaps are left.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Oren: Hi Rey, sorry to ask, but have you heard where the repair drive is supposed to be? Sam was checking with Cleo or Kira, and I’m trying not to lose the thread again.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rey: I haven’t heard a firm spot yet, Oren — only that folks are still sorting the basics. I can quietly ask Sam or Cleo next time I see them and pass it back to you.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey, I’d appreciate that. If you hear from Sam or Cleo, could you maybe tell me twice—or make me write it down?
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rey: Hi Sam, I’m trying to keep the repair drive details straight — have you and Cleo or Kira settled on a location yet?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Sam: Not yet, Rey—I’m still waiting on the final location and schedule details, but I’ll let you know as soon as they’re confirmed.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — I’ll hold off on telling people anything firm, then. When you hear, could you tell me once clearly so I can pass it to Oren and help him write it down?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: Hi Pia, I’m starting to gather names for tools and table space, and Gus said he can help spot gaps once I have a short list. Do we know the setup location yet, or is that still being settled?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Yes, Rosa confirmed it’s Sunday at the community center, with the community room as the main drop-off. Could you send her your tool and table-space list as you gather it, and flag anything Gus thinks we’re short on?
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rey: Yes, I can do that. I’ll send Rosa the list as it comes together and note any gaps after Gus has a look.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: Hi Eli, I keep coming back to your simple plan — needs, skills, tools, and one Saturday morning. Do you want me to quietly start asking neighbors what they need fixed and what they can lend?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Eli: Yes, please, Rey — that would help a great deal. If you can jot down each neighbor’s repair need, any tools they can lend, and whether they’re free 10 to noon Saturday, I’ll keep the master list tidy.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Rey: Sure, Eli — I’ll ask quietly and note each repair need, lendable tools, and whether they’re free Saturday from 10 to noon. I’ll bring you whatever I gather so your master list stays tidy.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: Hi Uli, I’m still piecing the repair drive together quietly — are you thinking more about bringing something to fix, lending tools, or helping with setup?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Uli: Mostly helping with setup and keeping the details straight, Rey. I’m going to check the notice board for the sign-up times before I point anyone the wrong way.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli — that would help a lot. If you see the times posted, could you let me know so I can keep asking neighbors about repairs and tools without sending them in circles?
events.speaker: Rey
